title: SEG Witnesses Edge
description: Schema for a Witnesses edge in the Safety Evidence Graph. Direction: TestOutcome → Implementation. Created automatically by the CI pipeline. Sink edge: no suspicion propagation, no edgeHash, no linkState. The verification mechanism for this edge is the seg:repoBSha field stored on the TestOutcome node — not a field on the edge itself. At proof generation time, the implementation extractor is rerun against repo B at that SHA and the resulting node hashes are confirmed to match those stored in repo G. A mismatch means the graph describes a different implementation state than the one the test actually ran against.

seg:from.description: IRI of the TestOutcome node — the one that witnesses.

seg:to.description: IRI of the Implementation node — the one being witnessed. Verification that this node's content is consistent with seg:repoBSha on the TestOutcome is performed at proof generation time.
